boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Stevens environments documented by the university as lounge or outdoor spaces, plus the campus library.

cards.title: Samuel C. Williams Library
cards.subtitle: Castle Point Terrace campus
cards.notes: Set up with your own materials, then use the library’s quiet carrels, collaboration areas, reservable study rooms, workstations, and scanning tools.
cards.short_summary: A library setting with individual, group, reservable, and computer-equipped options.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens says the library provides quiet individual carrels, collaboration spaces, reservable study rooms, computer workstations, and printing/scanning.
cards.source_title: Student Services | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Stevens states that all members of the Stevens community are welcome; reservable rooms may have separate booking requirements.

cards.title: Wesley J. Howe Center Lobby
cards.subtitle: First Floor, Wesley J. Howe Center
cards.notes: Use the first-floor lobby for a change of scene between classes; bring headphones if you need to concentrate in an open lounge setting.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor campus lounge option.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens lists the Wesley J. Howe Center Lobby on the first floor among its campus lounge spaces.
cards.source_title: Welcome Alumni and Friends | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Listed by Stevens as a campus lounge space; confirm building access and seating availability on arrival.

cards.title: Gina M. Addeo ’86 Commons East
cards.subtitle: First Floor, University Center Complex
cards.notes: Bring a laptop for an open commons session, and use this first-floor University Center Complex lounge for reading or collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: A named commons lounge in the University Center Complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens lists Gina M. Addeo ’86 Commons East on the first floor of the University Center Complex as a lounge space.
cards.source_title: Welcome Alumni and Friends | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Listed by Stevens as a lounge space; confirm building access and seating availability on arrival.

cards.title: University Center Complex Ground-Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: Ground Floor, University Center Complex
cards.notes: Choose this ground-floor lounge when you want a communal indoor base for independent reading, planning, or a low-key group check-in.
cards.short_summary: A named ground-floor University Center Complex lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens lists a Lounge on the ground floor of the University Center Complex among its campus lounge spaces.

cards.access_notes: Listed by Stevens as a lounge space; confirm building access and seating availability on arrival.

cards.title: Rosa and John Hovey ’57 Stairs
cards.subtitle: Gateway Academic Center North
cards.notes: Take a brief reading or review session on the named stairs; keep bags clear of the path and move on if the space is needed for circulation.

cards.evidence_claim: Stevens lists the Rosa and John Hovey ’57 Stairs in Gateway Academic Center North among its lounge spaces.

cards.access_notes: Listed by Stevens as a lounge space; use only without obstructing stair circulation.
